Cheap meat buffet we trust most
Mar 2026 • Couples
The cheap meat buffet we trust the most. Although compared to a year ago, the quality has gone down, but 179k at noon is still the best.
179k will have as many as 9 types of pork / roasted chicken + tokbokki (gongos, which smells a little peppery 🤣) + seaweed (gongos always) + 6 types of panchan + cheese butter + cheese fried rice. Meat looks good in general, with salad vs kenip vegetables also burned, there is nothing to eat
The boring point is that the buffet cows are not very impressive, the price of the buffet cows is over aburiya eating more :v

1000% recommend
Dec 2023 • Couples
We knew we had to check out this restaurant after we saw it had a perfect 5 stars score and 29K reviews on Google . THE VERDICT IS …IT DEFINITELY LIVED UP TO THE HYPE. We texted them on what’s app in advance to make a reservation and was seated very quickly. The restaurant was beautiful decorated and made us feel like we were in Korea! We soon found out that the owner was Korean and I believe his wife was Vietnamese so we knew it was going to be legit!! Price was super affordable and the quality of meat was great. Huge variety of meats and they keep it coming until you say you are full. There was pork, beef, shrimp, oyster, chicken - literally everything. My husband is Korea and he approved. Our server, Vinh was really sweet and attentive to our needs. Vinh and the owner bbq all our meats for us and made sure all our side dishes were refilled. Vinh also kept checking on us - service was top notch! Our special ayce also came with Korean kimchi soup, seaweed soup. We also love that they have the melted cheese corn and egg around the bbq. 10000% recommend checking this gem out!

Food was very good
Apr 2023 • Friends
Came here as I have seen the rave reviews and all the 5 stars so was very curious.

Immediate impressions were not great as the waiting staff took forever to get us, a couple, a seat despite the place half empty..... bit headless......but eventually we got a seat....
The staff all have head phones and all the techie stuff which seems to cause more confusion than anything else........keep it simple lads, simple, tut tut, otherwise you look real foolish.

Before we sat down we were also told in no uncertain terms that there was a time limit of 2 hours......which was nice, considering the only delays were with the staff finding us a seat, giving us the menu, and brining us our food......
A nice welcome indeed! Sheesh! 

Anyway, we sat down and ordered a lot of meat and some vegetables - don't ask me what exactly we ordered, but it was mostly beef, the odd sausage, some bacon rashers, and other assortments of meat - hell its a BBQ so lets all go crazy!
There was the odd bit of veg to accompany, and even a small bit of cheese, which was very random.
It was all good and very delicious, and watered down with some beer......all in all good food and well presented and damn tasty. 

The food was excellent, tasty and the variety of dishes was interesting to see.
and .the price coming to about 35 quid was ok. 

The restaurant filled up pretty quickly and the atmosphere was ok, even though its a big place it does feel crowded..they could do with a spring cleaning and get rid of the tat and give the customers more space.

Food was very good, but i have had better BBQs - (the Japanese place I reviewed to name but a few)

I drop a mark for the service which left a bit of a sour taste. ....one word: clueless.
